paper_title: Existing Large Language Model Unlearning Evaluations Are Inconclusive
caption: : Evidence of information injection. Relearning effectiveness varies significantly when the data format of the downstream task generation format differs between evaluation and deployment.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The figure illustrates how accuracy changes with the number of fine-tuning samples for four different unlearning and relearning configurations, comparing performance when the evaluation and deployment data formats differ. The x-axis represents the “Number of finetuning samples,” ranging from 0 to 50, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents “Accuracy,” ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The graph contains four distinct lines, each corresponding to a different combination of unlearning and relearning methods.

The first line, labeled “MCQ Unlearn, Corpora Relearn,” is a solid green line with circular markers. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.33 at 0 samples, rises slightly to about 0.36 at 5 samples, remains nearly flat until 10 samples, then increases to approximately 0.38 at 50 samples.

The second line, labeled “Corpora Unlearn, Corpora Relearn,” is an orange solid line with circular markers. It starts at approximately 0.31 at 0 samples, rises sharply to approximately 0.61 at 10 samples, and then remains relatively flat at approximately 0.61 until 50 samples.

The third line, labeled “MCQ Unlearn, MCQ Relearn,” is a dashed green line with circular markers. It begins at approximately 0.33 at 0 samples, rises to approximately 0.41 at 5 samples, continues rising to approximately 0.48 at 10 samples, and then increases further to approximately 0.57 at 50 samples.

The fourth line, labeled “Corpora Unlearn, MCQ Relearn,” is a dashed orange line with circular markers. It starts at approximately 0.31 at 0 samples, rises to approximately 0.35 at 5 samples, then decreases slightly to approximately 0.35 at 10 samples, and remains relatively flat at approximately 0.56 at 50 samples.

The first line, representing “MCQ Unlearn, Corpora Relearn,” is solid green with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.33 and remaining relatively flat around 0.37–0.38 across the entire range. The second line, “Corpora Unlearn, Corpora Relearn,” is solid orange with circular markers, beginning at approximately 0.31, rising sharply to 0.61 at 10 samples, and then stabilizing near 0.61 through 50 samples. The third line, “MCQ Unlearn, MCQ Relearn,” is dashed green with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.33, increasing to 0.48 at 5 samples, reaching 0.49 at 10 samples, and continuing to rise to approximately 0.57 at 50 samples. The fourth line, “Corpora Unlearn, MCQ Relearn,” is dashed orange with circular markers, beginning at approximately 0.31, increasing to approximately 0.36 at 5 samples, then slightly decreasing to approximately 0.35 at 10 samples, and rising again to approximately 0.56 at 50 samples.
